condition: dig_threshold_desc:I use this strategy once my number hits the 20s. I leave the planet when the number is anywhere between 20 and 29.
planet: surprise_desc:I use this strategy when the number of gems in each dig goes down much slower than other planets. It's usually if it goes down in increments of 10-15
n_prac_rounds: dynamic_desc:I use this strategy when each dig gives me over 50 gems for a while.
aliens: feedback:My only complaint is that sometimes my button presses don't register. I've been having to spam the A key for it to register 1 dig sometimes. Other than that
reward_received: I love the designs of the aliens! They're all cute and unique. I also appreciate how the pile of gems get small per dig. It's a nice touch that makes the game feel more interactive! I had a fun time. Thank you!}
